purpose: Determine whether A1's local advantage over A0 is explained only by unequal resource/time allocation.
interpretation: A1's local improvement over A0 survives equal deterministic resource budgets, so unequal compute/time alone does not explain the A1>A0 result in this benchmark. However, the neutral verification-only baseline remains better than both A0 and A1 at full budget, showing that the weighted orchestration layer is still not competitive here.
critical_limitation: The test does not isolate real cognitive capabilities such as world modeling, reasoning, failure learning, metacognition or autonomous self-improvement. It remains a deterministic synthetic model-selection harness.
next_action: Do not promote A1. Build the six executable capability experiments with matched sham controls and a competitive neutral baseline before any 36-job campaign.
claim_limit: This result rejects only a narrow resource-allocation-only explanation for A1>A0 inside BENCH-005. It is not evidence of AGI, superintelligence, autonomous learning, or external generalization.
